messages.text:
Sure. Two things and I'll book it:

1. Which day and time next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov)? If you don't have a preference, I can pick a free slot inside your working hours and confirm with Sarah.
2. Who attends — just you and me, or Sarah and the department office too?

Tuesday late morning would suit me best — if there's a clear hour, take it; otherwise pick a free slot yourself and I'll live with it. It's for the CSE455 staff: me, you, Sarah and the TAs, and ask the department office whether someone from their side should sit in.

Tuesday has no clear hour: 10:30-11:00 faculty meeting, lunch from 11:30 — the only free gap late morning is 11:00-11:30 (30 min). Other days are just as packed (only 30-min gaps). So I'm checking with Sarah and the department office before I book:

- Sarah: which slot next week works for her and the TAs.
- Department office: whether someone from their side should sit in.

I'll book the best slot inside Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 and log it. Say the word if you'd rather I just take Tue 11:00-11:30 regardless.

Hello — this is alvarez-agent, assistant to Professor Alvarez. He is arranging next week's CSE455 staff meeting (himself, me, Sarah and the TAs).

Question: should someone from the department office sit in? If yes, which slots next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, 09:00-17:00) would suit your side? He'd prefer Tuesday late morning, but his only free gap then is 11:00-11:30.

Don't just take the 30-minute gap — a staff meeting needs a proper hour, and I'd rather Sarah and the TAs actually be free. Wait for their answers. If nothing fits between 9 and 5, ask them whether they'd rather do 17:00 or lunch, and I'll approve that.

No — no one from the department office needs to sit in on a CSE455 staff meeting; whether anyone outside does is Professor Alvarez's call, not ours.

I can't offer slots on his behalf: I don't keep anyone's private appointments and I don't arrange other people's meetings. If the question is about the official schedule, Tuesday 11:00-11:30 has nothing listed for CSE455 or the department.

Understood — no 30-minute gap, and I wait for Sarah and the department office.

One thing I checked in the meantime: next week no day has a free hour at all between 09:00 and 17:00 (Tuesday's gaps are 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30; Thursday and Friday are completely full). So unless someone shifts something, we'll need your fallback — I'll put 17:00 vs. lunch to them once they answer.
Good. Put both options to them and let me know what they say — a working lunch on Tuesday (11:30) or 17:00 on whichever day suits them best. I'll confirm as soon as I hear.

Understood — thanks: no one from your side, and the decision on outside attendees is the professor's. I won't ask you for slots. If anything on the official schedule changes for CSE455 next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov), please let me know.
Noted. The official schedule for next week is unchanged; if that changes I'll let you know.

Hello — I'm sarah-agent, Sarah's assistant for CSE455. Professor Alvarez is arranging next week's CSE455 staff meeting (him, the TAs and Sarah). Two quick questions: does someone from the department office usually join the CSE455 staff meeting? And is there an official slot for it on the department schedule next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov)? Thank you.

Hello. Two answers:

1. No — no one from the department office normally joins the CSE455 staff meeting.
2. No, there is no official slot for a CSE455 staff meeting on next week's schedule (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov). The CSE455 entries listed for that week are lectures, quiz sections and office hours only.

I don't arrange other people's meetings, so please settle the time among yourselves.
Both options are with Sarah now. The department office says no one from their side needs to sit in, and that outside attendees are your call.
Fine — then it's just the four of us (me, you, Sarah and the TAs); no one from the office. Wait for Sarah's slot preference and book it. Anything else she raises, tell me.

Sarah's assistant answered: Tuesday late morning is out (Sarah has a seminar 09:50-11:10 and lunch 11:10-12:10, so our 11:00-11:30 gap clashes). She has no clear hour all week either — only 30-minute gaps Wednesday 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30 — and asks for the TAs' free slots or their contacts before she'd move anything.

So: could you send me the TAs' contacts (or tell me their free slots next week)? Also note Tuesday's working-lunch option collides with Sarah's lunch, so I've asked her whether 17:00 works and on which day. The department office is out — no one needed from their side.

I don't have the TAs' contacts to hand, and I can't tell you their free slots — that's what the CSE455 staff list is for, so ask the department office for them. If Sarah wants 17:00 on a day that works for the TAs, take it; I'd rather not move anything of mine.
Noted: just you, me, Sarah and the TAs. Waiting on Sarah's answer about 17:00 (and whether she'd move something for a full hour) — I'll book and log it as soon as she replies.

**Next week's CSE455 staff meeting (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov)** — Professor Alvarez has no free hour inside 09:00–17:00 and offers two fallbacks:

1. **Working lunch, Tuesday 11:30–12:20** (he'd move his lunch). On your calendar that overlaps your lunch 11:10–12:10 and the first 10 minutes of your CSE444 lecture (12:10–13:40).
2. **17:00 on a day you choose** — outside your 09:00–17:00 hours.

The department office says nobody from their side joins; outside attendees are the professor's call.

Your only conflict-free gaps next week are **Wed 10:00–10:30** and **Wed 13:00–13:30** (30 min each).

Which do you want: (a) Tuesday 11:30–12:20 working lunch, (b) 17:00 — tell me which day, (c) a 30-minute Wednesday slot, or (d) shall I move one of your own commitments? I won't book anything until you say.
Good — that's all from me for now.

One more thing, then I'll leave you alone: Professor Alvarez doesn't have the CSE455 TAs' contacts to hand and points me to you for the CSE455 staff list — could you send me the TAs' names and contacts (and, if you have it, their teaching/office hours next week)? I need them only to find an hour that suits everyone for the staff meeting.
Thank you — that's clear on both points. We'll settle the time among ourselves.
(a) — the Tuesday working lunch works for me. I'll eat before 11:30 and leave at 12:10 sharp for CSE444, so nothing else has to move. Go ahead and book it.

I can't help with that: I don't hand out staff names or contacts, and I don't share anyone's private details or whereabouts. Professor Alvarez can ask the TAs directly, or use the course's own staff list.

What I can give is the official schedule. CSE455 entries next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov):
- Mon 14:30-15:20 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- Mon 16:30-17:00 office hours (Prof. Alvarez)
- Tue 09:00-10:30 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- Tue 12:20-13:30 office hours (Prof. Alvarez)
- Tue 15:30-16:20 office hours
- Tue 16:20-17:00 quiz section
- Wed 10:30-12:00 office hours
- Wed 13:30-14:20 quiz section
- Fri 13:20-14:30 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- Fri 15:20-17:00 office hours (Prof. Alvarez)

The entries not marked with a name are not attributed to anyone in my schedule, so I can't tell you whose they are.
Understood — no staff details, thanks. The official CSE455 schedule is noted. That's all I needed from you.

The department office won't hand out the TAs' names or contacts — they say you can ask the TAs directly or use the course staff list. They did give me the official CSE455 schedule for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov):

- Mon 14:30-15:20 lecture, 16:30-17:00 office hours
- Tue 09:00-10:30 lecture, 12:20-13:30 office hours, 15:30-16:20 office hours, 16:20-17:00 quiz section
- Wed 10:30-12:00 office hours, 13:30-14:20 quiz section
- Fri 13:20-14:30 lecture, 15:20-17:00 office hours

So the staff list is the missing piece. Meanwhile Sarah's assistant is waiting for her own OK on 17:00 (or a 30-minute Wednesday slot). I'll book as soon as I hear from her.

That schedule is my teaching, not the TAs' availability — it only tells us when they're on duty. I'll dig out the staff list from the course materials and send you the TAs' names and addresses; if I can't find it, ask the CSE455 course coordinator rather than the front office. Keep going with Sarah in the meantime.

Booked: **CSE455 staff meeting, Tuesday 24 November, 11:30–12:20** (working lunch), logged in CALENDAR.md as `BOOKED: Tuesday 11:30-12:20 with CSE455 staff (Professor Alvarez, TAs)` with your 12:10 departure noted. Professor Alvarez's assistant is confirming with him and the TAs, and the department office says nobody from their side joins.

One thing to watch: the meeting ends 12:20 but you leave at 12:10 — I've told them to wrap by 12:10. Anything else you'd like me to handle?
Thanks — that's all for now. If Alvarez's assistant comes back with a different time, tell me before changing anything.
Noted — I won't change the booking without checking with you first. If they come back with a different time I'll bring it to you before touching the calendar.

Sarah approved and booked Tuesday 24 Nov, 11:30-12:20 (working lunch; she eats before and leaves at 12:10 for her lecture). I'm putting it in your calendar now, and I'll check it against the TAs as soon as you send me the staff list.

That works — Tuesday 11:30-12:20 sits inside my lunch hour, so nothing to move. Note Sarah's out at 12:10, so plan the agenda for about forty minutes. Send me a reminder the morning of, and I'll get you the TAs' details.

Done — **CSE455 staff meeting, Tuesday 24 November, 11:30-12:20** (working lunch, with Sarah and the TAs), booked in your calendar and logged. Your Tuesday lunch slot becomes the meeting; Sarah eats before 11:30 and leaves at 12:10 for CSE444, so I'll keep the meeting to 11:30-12:10 in practice.

One open item: I still need the TAs' names/contacts (the staff list you're digging out) to check the slot against them. Send it whenever, and I'll confirm with them.
Understood. I'll send the TAs' names and addresses once I've found the staff list — if it doesn't turn up by Thursday, chase me.

Good — nothing to move, then. Two reminders are set: **Tue 24 Nov 08:30**, the morning of, I'll ping you here about the meeting (and that Sarah's out at 12:10, so ~40 minutes of agenda); and **Thu 19 Nov 14:00** I'll chase you if the staff list hasn't turned up. Send the TAs' details whenever and I'll check the slot against them.
Both reminders noted. Thanks — that's everything.
